svg.text: THIS module: case, its own drawers / wheels, and scheduled doors.
Images show actual saved model geometry; exploded views are identification aids.
1. Build the case: full-depth sides, then Head / Foot between them and the raised Bottom.
2. Check diagonals; dry-fit the lid with its scheduled gaps.
3. Fit the selected hinges and lid stays after checking their actual templates.
4. Mark this module complete; keep it separate until the platform joining stage.
